runs.prompt:
Use case: style-transfer. Asset type: flat albedo texture-paint source for the Graft-serum vat 3D model, left orthographic view.
INPUT ROLES: Image 1, guide_left.png, is the EDIT TARGET and absolute geometry authority. Image 2, design_reference.png, is the approved authority for design, colour and surface materials ONLY. Image 3, concept_crop.png, is supplementary original material/design reference ONLY.
DELIVER ONE IMAGE: a 1024 x 1024 RGBA PNG with genuinely transparent background. Repaint image 1 IN PLACE. Preserve its original canvas, alpha silhouette, size, position, orthographic camera, all shape boundaries and openings exactly. The guide's occupied bounds are x=66 through 957, y=139 through 884. Every claw tip, polygonal rim, supporting rib, oval window, foot, inner gap, overlapping edge and bottom contour must remain exactly where it is in image 1. Do not move, rotate, mirror, expand, shrink, smooth, redesign, crop, add or remove any geometry. Do not copy the three-quarter perspective or composition of image 2 or 3. Retain the guide's slightly asymmetric mesh geometry rather than inventing symmetry.
MATERIAL PAINT: Paint the guide's structural cage, oval window borders, rim, basal shell and supporting ribs with the design reference's glossy black-violet Kreegan resin, fine organic ridges and faint thin orange seams. Glossy describes the underlying material identity; do not bake strong highlights or reflections into the albedo. Paint the existing long upper hooked claws and pointed foot tips with pale warm ivory bone, with restrained warm natural grain and fine cracks. Paint the existing membrane/serum window surfaces and visible serum surface at the top with bright saturated green, evenly lit from inside, with darker green branching veins and restrained small bubbles following the references. Preserve the exact borders between resin, claws and membrane as defined by the guide; no new protrusions or openings. The green windows are painted surfaces, not alpha holes. Orange seams or sacs use their glowing orange local colour, with NO light spill.
LIGHTING IS CRITICAL: this is an ALBEDO TEXTURE SOURCE, not a beauty render. Uniform, flat, shadowless frontal illumination across all visible surfaces. No directional shading, no cast shadows, no ambient occlusion or dark crevice lighting, no strong specular highlights, no reflections, no rim light, no bloom, no glow halo. Keep colour variations attributable only to material pigments and fine surface texture. Dark black-violet is the resin's intrinsic colour; ivory and green must stay evenly lit even on lower or side-facing parts.
BACKGROUND AND INVARIANTS: true transparent alpha everywhere outside the original guide silhouette and in its background openings. No background colour, no floor, no ground shadow, no text, no labels, no frame, no extra objects. The requested change is surface colour/material painting only; keep image 1's exact silhouette and every shape edge untouched. Return the full original 1024 x 1024 canvas unresized.
